profile.summary: Hello! I'm a software engineer who's always chasing faster and smarter ways to build. I have deep roots in full-stack development (APIs, databases, AWS, front-end experiences and everything in between) and I also lean on modern AI tools like Cursor, Claude, and Cline to stay sharp and move fast. I've mentored engineers, shaped architecture decisions, and I genuinely enjoy the process of building well-designed software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I design and build scalable, event-driven billing and subscription systems at Lob, working across the stack with Node.js (TypeScript), Vue/React, and AWS. My work spans usage metering, invoice generation, and pricing interfaces—supporting critical revenue operations and customer experience.

Currently working on a third-party billing system integration and contributing to our event-driven architecture using AWS SQS, AWS Lambda, Temporal, and more. I collaborate with Product, Finance, and Customer Success, and mentor engineers to promote best practices and a strong engineering culture.

I also leverage AI tools like Cursor, Claude, and Cline to boost development speed, explore design options, and improve team workflows.

Tech Stack: Node.js, TypeScript, Vue.js, React, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, AWS (SQS, Kinesis, RDS), Kafka, Docker, Nomad, Temporal, Kubernetes
AI Tools: Cursor, Claude, Cline

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Helped guide architectural decisions and collaborated with diverse teams to translate business requirements into effective solutions. Maintained high code quality through comprehensive reviews, mentoring junior engineers, and advocating innovative methodologies. Took ownership of issue resolution and system reliability using specialized company tools. Additionally, created technical implementation documentation and contributed to architectural review meetings with engineering leadership, thriving in collaborative settings across multiple time zones, including the US and India
